dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), Linux-based, GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL environment. Program ORCSNYUFTN handles inpatient burden amount calculation (負担金額算定サブ・入院用).

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software for Japanese medical institutions. This subprogram calculates inpatient patient burden amounts (負担金額算定) for hospitalization billing.
purpose.summary: Subprogram ORCSNYUFTN calculates inpatient patient burden amounts (負担金額) for the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It processes insurance combination data, inpatient accounting records, and treatment records to determine monthly insurance-based cost-sharing amounts for hospitalized patients. It calls several other ORCA subsystems (ORCS02, ORCSCHOZAI, ORCSDAY) and returns results via linkage section.

notable_features: 23 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPSYSKANRI, CPNYUINACCT, CPNYUINACT, CPSRYACCT, etc.)
33 CALL statements to ORCA subsystem programs
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA (MCP message control area)
OCCURS tables for insurance combination and day-based calculations
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
PERFORM VARYING with complex UNTIL conditions
EXIT PROGRAM / STOP RUN dual termination
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC-JP encoded text, resulting in mojibake in comments. This is characteristic of the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system distributed for Linux. The program is a subprogram (called via LINKAGE SECTION) within a larger ORCA application suite. Source is fixed-format with max line length 74, consistent with standard COBOL fixed format.
